thread.text: Hello! I'm writing because I'm a bit confused about my recent statement. I've been on the free plan for about two months now, but I noticed a charge for $297 labeled as seat management. I had a similar issue resolved previously, but it seems to have cropped up again.

Thank you for reaching out to us. I would be more than happy to look into these seat management charges for you. To get started, could you please confirm the email address associated with your account?

Of course, it's linked to my primary email. I'm just concerned because I haven't intentionally added any new users, and I'd like to understand why the system is triggering this billing amount for a free account.
I appreciate you providing that. To help me narrow down the cause, could you tell me if you've recently modified any sharing permissions or added any guest contributors to your projects?
I did share a read-only link with a colleague last week, but I didn't think that counted as a paid seat. I'd appreciate it if you could check if that action was what caused the $297 charge to appear.
